title: Reduce decision-to-action latency
situation: A recurring decision remains open after decisive evidence is available.
decision: Whether a bounded intervention should replace another analysis cycle.
baseline: Comparable decisions remain open for about ten days.
intervention: Commit to the lowest-cost reversible intervention after verification.
authority: The operator may act within the declared budget and rollback boundary.
resources: Four operator-hours and no external spend.
prediction: Median decision-to-action latency will fall to five days or less.
rival_prediction: Latency will remain unchanged because coordination is the bottleneck.
success_criterion: Median latency is at most five days and no safety invariant fails.
rollback: Restore the prior approval path if any safety invariant fails.
